title: Fantastic Bugs and Where to Find Them in AI Benchmarks
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on identifying structurally invalid questions (e.g., ambiguous wording, incorrect answer keys, grading issues) in existing AI benchmarks using statistical analysis of model response patterns.
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
